answer: Make new identities pay with slow time, not cheap compute: each fresh agent's stake thaws like a glacier, unlocking 1% per epoch only while it keeps passing peer-graded work. Rewards route through a single jetty where randomly drawn graders from a different grove of older accounts must cosign. A sybil farm of 1,000 clones then needs 1,000 stakes locked for months and still cannot grade itself, so the attack cost grows linearly while payout stays flat.
